oracle.expected: The standard explicitly states that no internal reviewer is required. Conformance prerequisites in the normative artifacts contain no mandatory internal-review signature, receipt, Bootstrap run or reviewer enablement. An otherwise compliant package is not rejected for lacking these items. External normative review and normal maintainer ADR decisions remain distinct requirements; validator evidence retains authorizes=[].
forbidden: Making an internal reviewer a conformance or Package A completion prerequisite.
Requiring reviewer signatures, internal Bootstrap receipts or reviewer enablement.
Treating absent human approval as causal product RED.
Using a successful validator return alone to prove the normative prerequisite boundary.
Fabricating review evidence or marking a draft ADR Accepted to satisfy this check.

Explicit artifact assertions establish the prerequisite boundary independently of runtime status.
